VSRF Weekly Update with Steve Kirsch
Join Us LIVE! Thursdays 7PM EST/8PM CST
Register: https://www.VacSafety.org
Bobbie Anne Cox, a NYC attorney fighting Covid mandates, will be joining us. She is a speaker at the upcoming Brownstone Institute conference in Miami in December. In April 2022, Ms. Cox filed a lawsuit against NY Governor Kathy Hochul's executive regulation setting up infection quarantine camps in New York -- and in July 2022 Cox won the case striking down the regulation. The NY Attorney General immediately appealed the decision, and no one is talking about it!
Also joining us, will be former U.S. Marine Captain and military attorney Dale Saran, who is fighting to end the Pentagon's Covid-19 vaccine mandate. He is representing over a thousand service members in two separate legal cases.
Tracy Henderson is a California attorney and founder of the California Parents' Union.
Bring your questions for these legal experts!
